title: Profile-Driven User Simulation via Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Rewards for Task-Oriented Dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2610.32435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems for high-value scenarios such as financial marketing requires large volumes of domain-specific dialogue data, which privacy regulations, annotation costs, and the need for expert labor make hard to obtain. User simulation offers a remedy, but existing methods target general-domain dialogue and exhibit two key limitations: insufficient modeling of domain-specific business processes and compliance constraints, and inadequate capture of the colloquial, spoken-language character of voice interactions. We propose ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls. It jointly models user profiles---demographics and Big Five personality traits---and business profiles---intents reverse-engineered from real call logs---enabling fine-grained control over simulated behavior. The base model is fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined by Group Relative

translated_title: 基于层级奖励强化学习的面向任务对话用户画像驱动用户模拟
translated_abstract: 为金融营销等高价值场景构建面向任务的对话（TOD）系统需要大量特定领域的对话数据，然而隐私法规、标注成本以及对专家人力的需求使这类数据难以获取。用户模拟提供了一种解决途径，但现有方法面向通用领域对话，存在两个关键局限：一是对特定领域业务流程与合规约束的建模不足，二是对语音交互中口语化、口头语言特征的捕捉不够充分。我们提出了ProfileSim，一个面向金融营销外呼电话的用户画像驱动用户模拟框架。该框架联合建模用户画像（人口统计特征与大五人格特质）与业务画像（从真实通话记录中逆向工程提取的意图），从而实现对模拟行为的细粒度控制。基座模型在真实语音对话数据上进行微调，并通过群组相对（策略优化）…（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ProfileSim框架，通过联合建模用户画像（人口统计与大五人格）和业务画像（从真实通话记录逆向提取的意图），并利用在真实语音数据上微调及带层级奖励的强化学习优化，实现了面向金融营销外呼场景、可细粒度控制的用户模拟。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls that jointly models user profiles (demographics and Big Five personality traits) and business profiles (intents reverse-engineered from real call logs), fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined via reinforcement learning with hierarchical rewards, enabling fine-grained control over simulated user behavior.
